_note: Player options (the Options screen), saved per player in user://options.json. Each is an on/off switch with its default; more kinds of option can come later.

battle_wait_for_fight.label: Show both squads before a battle and wait for Fight
battle_wait_for_fight.tip: Off: a battle starts playing as soon as it opens.

pause_on_focus_loss.label: Pause when the game window loses focus
pause_on_focus_loss.tip: Switching to another window pauses the map, or the battle if one is playing.
